tools.title: Create Attachment From Upload
tools.description:
Link an already-uploaded Linear assetUrl to an existing issue as an attachment.

Use this only after:
1. prepare_attachment_upload returned an assetUrl and uploadRequest.
2. The client successfully PUT raw file bytes to uploadRequest.url.

This tool does not upload file content. It only creates the Linear attachment row.
If the direct upload failed or the signed URL expired, rerun prepare_attachment_upload and upload again.

assetUrl.description: Linear upload assetUrl returned by prepare_attachment_upload

title.description: Attachment title. Defaults to filename or asset URL

tools.title: List Comments
tools.description: List comments on a Linear issue, project, initiative, document, project milestone, or project/initiative status update. Provide exactly one of `issueId`, `projectId`, `initiativeId`, `documentId`, `milestoneId`, or `statusUpdateId`. For issues, projects, and initiatives this returns both top-level discussion threads and inline description comments. Inline (anchored) comments carry a non-null `quotedText` set to the snippet of description text they reference. Returned comments include `author` and nullable `onBehalfOf`; when set, `onBehalfOf` identifies the user the agent author acted for. Files uploaded in comment bodies are returned in `attachments` with titles and download URLs, not issue attachment IDs. Signed upload URLs expire after five minutes; call list_comments again to refresh them. Download documents using these URLs and process them with your own file tools.

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues (provide exactly one parent)

projectId.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

initiativeId.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

documentId.description: Document ID or slug (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

statusUpdateId.description: Status update UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve status updates via `get_status_updates` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

tools.title: Save Comment
tools.description: Create or update a comment on a Linear issue, project, initiative, document, project milestone, or project/initiative status update. If `id` is provided, updates the existing comment; otherwise creates a new one. To start a new thread, pass `body` and exactly one of `issueId`, `projectId`, `initiativeId`, `documentId`, `milestoneId`, or `statusUpdateId` — comments on issues/projects/initiatives become top-level discussion threads; comments on documents/milestones become description comments. A status update holds a single thread, so a comment on an update that already has one is added to it as a reply. To reply to an existing thread, pass `parentId` and `body`; the reply inherits the parent's thread type, so no entity reference is needed. Parent reference fields are ignored when `id` or `parentId` is provided (`statusUpdateType` is rejected instead).

id.description: Comment ID. If provided, updates the existing comment

issueId.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues (provide exactly one parent)

projectId.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

initiativeId.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug (provide exactly one parent)

documentId.description: Document ID or slug (provide exactly one parent)

milestoneId.description: Milestone UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve milestone names via `list_milestones` first.

statusUpdateId.description: Status update UUID (provide exactly one parent). Resolve status updates via `get_status_updates` first.

statusUpdateType.description: Type of status update named by `statusUpdateId`, as returned by `get_status_updates`. Only valid together with `statusUpdateId`; omit to check both project and initiative status updates.

parentId.description: Parent comment ID (for replies, only when creating)

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

tools.description: Create, reply to, or edit a comment or persisted draft on a Linear diff. Set draft to true to save without submitting. Provide draftId to edit or submit a persisted draft, and commentId only to edit a submitted comment. Submitting an inline draft reuses its saved anchor; submitting a reply draft requires parentId again.

urlOrId.description: Linear review URL, diff slug, pull request ID, Linear full identifier, or GitHub PR URL

draftId.description: Existing persisted draft ID to edit or submit

draft.description: Save as a private persisted draft without submitting

parentId.description: Top-level comment ID to reply to; also required when submitting a persisted reply draft

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences

anchor.description: Optional comment anchor copied from a diff thread or built for a file or diff hunk

anchorContent.description: Exact source text of the anchor's end line; stored with an inline draft so it can be re-anchored after the diff receives new revisions

tools.title: Save Document

When creating, `title` is required and exactly one parent (`project`, `issue`, `initiative`, `cycle`, or `team`) must be specified. On update, passing a parent reparents the document. To change parts of the content without resending all of it, pass `patch` instead of `content`.

id.description: Document ID or slug to update. Omit to create a new document.

content.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

anchor.description: Exact text to insert before. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly before the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")

anchor.description: Exact text to insert after. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly after the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")

Text to insert at the very end of the content

from.description: Exact text where the range starts (inclusive). Must match exactly once

to.description: Exact text where the range ends (exclusive, stays in place). Must match exactly once after `from`

new_string.description: Text replacing the range. Empty string deletes it

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues

tools.description: Create or update release notes. If `id` is provided, updates the existing release notes; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `pipeline` and either `releases` or a release range are required. To change parts of the content without resending all of it, pass `patch` instead of `content`.

id.description: Release notes ID or slug to update. Omit to create new release notes.

pipeline.description: Release pipeline ID, slug, or exact name (required when creating)

content.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

patch.description: Partial edits applied to the current content, in order and atomically (one failing operation aborts the whole save). Every anchor string must match the current content exactly once. Only valid on update, in place of the full content/description field

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the current content exactly once

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the match

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match

anchor.description: Exact text to insert before. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly before the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")

anchor.description: Exact text to insert after. Must match the current content exactly once

text.description: Text to insert directly after the anchor. Include separators (e.g. "\n\n")
Text to insert at the very start of the content
Text to insert at the very end of the content

from.description: Exact text where the range starts (inclusive). Must match exactly once

to.description: Exact text where the range ends (exclusive, stays in place). Must match exactly once after `from`

new_string.description: Text replacing the range. Empty string deletes it

releases.description: Release IDs or slugs to include in the note

rangeFromRelease.description: Oldest release ID or slug in the note range

rangeToRelease.description: Newest release ID or slug in the note range

tools.title: Save Status Update
tools.description: Create or update a project/initiative status update. Omit `id` to create, provide `id` to update.

id.description: Status update ID - if provided, updates this existing update

project.description: Project name, ID, identifier (e.g., P-ENG-123), or slug

initiative.description: Initiative name, ID, identifier (e.g., I-123), or slug

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. To mention a user, use @displayName (e.g., @johndoe)

isDiffHidden.description: Deprecated. Hide diff with previous update (create only)

tools.title: Search Documentation
tools.description: Search Linear's documentation to learn about features and usage

tools.title: Share Issue
tools.description: Share an issue with a workspace user who cannot otherwise access it. Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to share the issue.

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues

user.description: User ID, name, email, or "me" Must be an email address or UUID.

tools.title: Submit Diff Review
tools.description: Approve a Linear diff, request changes, or submit a review comment

urlOrId.description: Linear review URL, diff slug, pull request ID, Linear full identifier, or GitHub PR URL

decision.description: Review decision: approved, changesRequested, or commented

body.description: Content as Markdown. Do not escape the string — use literal newlines and special characters, not escape sequences. Required when requesting changes or commenting

tools.title: Unshare Issue
tools.description: Remove a workspace user's shared access to an issue. Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to stop sharing the issue.

issue.description: Issue ID or identifier (e.g., LIN-123). P-prefixed identifiers (e.g., P-ENG-123) are projects, not issues

user.description: User ID, name, email, or "me" Must be an email address or UUID.

tools.title: Update Diff
tools.description: Update a Linear diff's title, description, reviewer requests, issue links, or status. Provide at least one update. Combined updates can partially succeed; inspect the result before retrying. Use merge_diff to merge and submit_diff_review to approve or request changes.

urlOrId.description: Linear review URL, diff slug, pull request ID, Linear full identifier, or GitHub PR URL

description.description: New description as Markdown; an empty string clears it

addedReviewRequests.description: Request or re-request reviews; existing pending requests are unchanged

user.description: Workspace user ID, name, email, or "me"

externalUserId.description: External user ID from get_diff reviewer metadata

githubTeamId.description: GitHub team ID from get_diff reviewer metadata

removedReviewRequests.description: Withdraw pending review requests; submitted reviews are preserved

user.description: Workspace user ID, name, email, or "me"

externalUserId.description: External user ID from get_diff reviewer metadata

githubTeamId.description: GitHub team ID from get_diff reviewer metadata

addedIssueLinks.description: Add issue links or change the relationship of an existing link

type.description: Relationship: closes, contributes, links, or reopens

removedIssueLinks.description: Linear issue identifiers or UUIDs to unlink

statusAction.description: Status transition to perform after metadata is updated

verificationNotes: Owner-authorized publication-first testing used one authenticated Linear OAuth session to capture the provider tools/list catalog. The 65 admitted tools are pinned as a reviewed-subset catalog; two attachment-upload tools with provider descriptions above the current bounded Marketplace description limit remain excluded from this first release. Reads require approval, writes require approval, and destructive mutations require approval. Linear metadata documents Streamable HTTP, dynamic OAuth 2.1 registration, PKCE S256, read/write scopes, refresh tokens, and token revocation. Workspace identity remains an opaque connection because no reviewed identity projection was established. Live acceptance, privacy review, and provider catalog drift remain pending.
